mechanism: Both drugs can reduce renal perfusion and increase serum potassium; dorzolamide (carbonic anhydrase inhibitor) causes metabolic acidosis which may potentiate ACE inhibitor effects on electrolytes and renal function.
action: Monitor serum potassium, creatinine, and renal function periodically; ensure adequate hydration; use with caution in patients with baseline renal impairment or hyperkalemia risk.
